t: Robust and versatile UV-resistant tape with medium adhesion. Features premium backing tape to ensure flex within the tape, which allows some movement when applied to surfaces. Able to withstand multiple coats of paint. Suitable for use on most indoor and outdoor surfaces, including walls, ceilings, metal, wood and glass. Easy to tear, with clean removal up to 14 days after application.
b: Apply to Clean, Dry, Non-Delicate Surfaces
